summary: Iteration 5 enhancements (Public Queue TV / Book-Next CTA / Cmd+K Command Palette) validated end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass on /api/queue/public/{clinic_id} — returns 200 unauth with correct shape {clinic, now_serving, next_up, total_waiting, fetched_at}, 404 for bogus clinic, NO sensitive fields leaked (patient_id/mobile/mrd absent), patient_name redacted to 'First L.' format ('TESTQTV K.' from 'TESTQTV Ramesh Kumar'), sibling /api/tokens still 401 without Bearer, polling-freshness verified (newly issued token visible within 3s), and a paid invoice exists for the Book-Next CTA test. Frontend: /queue/clinic-acs-demo loads WITHOUT login (no redirect), shows ACS Audiology Clinic name, Mumbai city, big clock (02:14), 'Now Serving' + 'Next in Queue' sections with empty-state copy in English+Hindi. Cmd+K (Meta+K) AND Ctrl+K AND topbar trigger button (data-testid='cmdk-trigger') all open palette; ESC closes. Empty palette shows 8 quick actions with hint keys (N/R/A/I/—/—/D/Q). Typing 'test' (2+ chars) returned both 'Patients' and 'Invoices' result sections (debounced search worked). Single-key 'A' (outside input) navigated to /frontdesk/appointments; typing 'd' INSIDE cmdk input did NOT navigate (value 'd' stayed in input). Book-Next CTA: visible on PAID invoice INV-150AB175-A (data-testid='inv-book-next'), HIDDEN on DRAFT invoice INV-FF0EA1C3-E. Clicking it navigated to /frontdesk/appointments AND auto-opened BookAppointmentModal with patient_name='TEST_BILL Intra MH' pre-filled and date=2026-05-22 (+30d from today 22 Apr 2026). Audiologist role: nav-billing hidden as expected, Cmd+K palette still shows 'New Invoice' action (universal palette per spec — backend gates).

issues: Recurring React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' surfaced again when navigating from /billing list to a detail page (carryover from iter_3/iter_4 — root cause: dynamic JSX expression inside <option> labels in the service catalogue dropdown). Not functional, but pollutes console on every page mount.

action_items: (Carryover, not regressed) Fix the <span> in <option> hydration warning in CreateInvoicePage.js around the service catalogue dropdown — render the option label as a plain string.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_queue endpoint correctly excludes patient_id/mobile/mrd from the projection ({_id:0, token_no:1, patient_name:1, service:1, status:1, called_at:1, issued_at:1}) — privacy redaction is enforced both by projection AND by the _redact() function. Good defense-in-depth.

Public endpoint has no rate-limit. For a TV-display polling every 5s that's fine, but a malicious actor could enumerate clinic IDs (404 vs 200). Consider clinic_id format whitelist or basic per-IP rate-limit if exposed beyond LAN.
_redact() uses last token's first character — for single-word names returns full name (e.g., 'Madhuri'). Acceptable per spec (privacy-best-effort), but worth documenting.

public_queue uses `today_start = datetime.utcnow()` with no IST offset. For a Mumbai clinic running past 5:30am UTC (=11am IST), this is fine, but tokens issued after 18:30 IST will roll into the next UTC day and disappear from the TV until midnight IST. Document the UTC-day assumption or switch to clinic-timezone-aware day boundaries.

InvoiceDetailPage.js sends `suggestedDate: followUp.toISOString()` and AppointmentsPage parses it via `new Date(...)` — works, but the time component will be 'now' UTC which may translate to an off-hour local time (test showed 10:00 AM IST default — likely the modal's own default override, good).

Book-Next button only shows on status==='paid'. Spec also says 'fully-paid' — code uses inv.status which is correct (paid_total >= grand_total). No edge-case for refunded paid invoices but those aren't modelled yet.
AppointmentsPage uses `location.state?.bookForPatient` — if user manually refreshes /frontdesk/appointments, the state is lost. Acceptable for one-shot CTA flow but document.
CommandPalette debounce is fine; result section headers 'Patients' and 'Invoices' confirmed visible. ArrowUp/ArrowDown not exhaustively keyboard-tested but trigger and ESC both fire correctly.
